tabs.heading: Who is JetZero
tabs.text: JetZero is a pioneering aerospace start-up focused on revolutionizing air travel by developing cutting-edge aircraft technology that prioritizes efficiency, sustainability and the entire passenger experience. Founded with the mission to address the challenges of modern aviation, JetZero combines digital design and advanced manufacturing technologies with visionary thinking to create solutions that are both practical and groundbreaking. The company's commitment to reducing the environmental impact of air travel while enhancing the overall flying experience has positioned it as a leader in the aerospace industry.

tabs.heading: Siemens Partnership
tabs.text: Siemens and JetZero aim to demonstrate how digitalization is empowering JetZero to transform the aviation industry by designing, certifying and building the world's first digital native aircraft. The planned "factory of the future" will be an industry-leading model for digital manufacturing that can be applied across diverse sectors. The overarching goal is to amplify the story of JetZero's innovative approach, demonstrating how digitalization can turn visionary ideas into industry-shaping realities.

tabs.heading: Technologies to Scale
tabs.text:
• Siemens Xcelerator open digital business platform
  • The comprehensive Digital Twin
  • Industrial grade AI
  • Advanced data analytics
  • Software-defined automation
  • Electrification, Switchgear and building technologies
  • Industrial Metaverse

tabs.heading: Benefits
tabs.text:
The Siemens Xcelerator Open Business platform will enable accelerated design, adaptable manufacturing and digital testing and validation, shaving years off of development time while enabling JetZero to meet and exceed global aviation certification standards for safety, quality and reliability. The Z4 aircraft promises up to 50 percent better fuel efficiency and an elevated passenger experience, addressing growing demand for air travel while contributing to the aviation industry's decarbonization goals by 2050.

Siemens' collaboration with JetZero is a testament to how innovative partnerships can drive industry transformation, setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability and customer experience in aviation.
